region.name: North Shore MA (MassGIS) — Swampscott
region.description: Built from MassGIS statewide standardized assessor parcels (FY2026): address/year-built/unit-count/living-area observed; base_price = a DOR ratio-study market estimate (assessed / local assessed-to-sale ratio from recent sales); per-unit bedrooms assigned by quantile-mapping living-area/unit onto the ACS bedroom marginal (2019-23 5yr PUMS, Essex Co, 2-4 unit renters) so the region bedroom mix equals ACS; rents median-by-bedroom. Government + Census sourced, reproducible, redistributable; no scraped data.
region.provenance: MassGIS Massachusetts_Property_Tax_Parcels FeatureServer + ACS 2019-23 5yr PUMS (bedroom marginal, sqft-quantile assignment); params held constant vs regions/salem_reference_v2

INC.EarnerMedianAnnual.source: Renter median household income $78,018 (ACS 2019-2023 5yr B25119_003E, Swampscott MA) x Salem earner/household calibration 0.938.

OPEX.PropertyTaxPerUnit.source: FY2025 residential rate $11.47/$1000 (MA DOR DLS Tax Rates by Class) x median per-unit assessed $366,900 (MassGIS FY2026 roll). Current basis.

OPEX.InsurancePerUnit.source: MA small-building BOP proxy $1,400/unit (same basis as Salem; not town-differentiated).

INF.Surge_OpExMean.source: Surge regime: annual OpEx mean (lags rent 6-12mo; runs hot — MA insurance +15-30%/yr).

MARKET.DailyListingBasePct.source: Steady-state listed share used to derive the daily listing probability (BasePct / WindowDays, then seasonal multiplier). Was hardcoded 0.015 — independent of InitListedPctMid despite the shared value.

MARKET.DailyListingWindowDays.source: Divisor turning DailyListingBasePct into a per-day probability. Was hardcoded 30.

MARKET.DaysOnMarket_Mean.source: Mean days-on-market for a listing. Essex County MLS calibration. Was ProjectionConstants.DaysOnMarket_Mean.

MARKET.DaysOnMarket_SeasonalMultiplier_J.source: Days-on-market seasonal multiplier, Jan (winter listings sit longer).

MARKET.DaysOnMarketMaxDays.source: Clamp ceiling for sampled days-on-market. Was hardcoded 365.

MARKET.DaysOnMarketMinDays.source: Clamp floor for sampled days-on-market. Was hardcoded 3.

MARKET.Hold10YrDays.source: 10-year bucket boundary / long-tail base (days). Was hardcoded 3650.

MARKET.HoldCapDays.source: Hold-period cap (30 years, days). Was hardcoded 10950.

MARKET.HoldFlipMinDays.source: Minimum hold for the flip bucket (days). Was hardcoded 90.

MARKET.HoldLT10YrCumPct.source: Hold-period cum threshold: P(hold < 10yr) = 29% (+9% 5-10yr); remainder 71% holds 10yr+. Was hardcoded 0.29.

MARKET.HoldLT2YrCumPct.source: Hold-period cum threshold: P(hold < 2yr) = 6% (flips). 40k+ multi-family owner survey. Was hardcoded 0.06 (dup of retired HoldPeriod_LessThan2Yr_Pct).

MARKET.HoldLT5YrCumPct.source: Hold-period cum threshold: P(hold < 5yr) = 20% (6% flip + 14% 2-5yr). Was hardcoded 0.20.

MARKET.HoldTailMeanYears.source: Mean additional years past 10 in the exponential long tail. Was hardcoded 8.

MARKET.InitAvailablePctJitter.source: Seed-based uniform jitter half-width applied to InitAvailablePctMid. Was hardcoded 0.01.

MARKET.InitAvailablePctMax.source: Clamp ceiling for the zero-day Available share. Was hardcoded 0.05.

MARKET.InitAvailablePctMid.source: Zero-day % of properties Available (not listed, not held), midpoint. Was hardcoded 0.04.

MARKET.InitAvailablePctMin.source: Clamp floor for the zero-day Available share. Was hardcoded 0.03.

MARKET.InitListedPctJitter.source: Seed-based uniform jitter half-width applied to InitListedPctMid. Was hardcoded 0.005.

MARKET.InitListedPctMax.source: Clamp ceiling for the zero-day Listed share. Was hardcoded 0.02.

MARKET.InitListedPctMid.source: Zero-day % of properties in Listed state, midpoint (synthetic steady-state, Q&A Option B). Jittered ±InitListedPctJitter then clamped. Was hardcoded 0.015.

MARKET.InitListedPctMin.source: Clamp floor for the zero-day Listed share. Was hardcoded 0.01.

MARKET.SeasonalMultiplier_Jan.source: Listing-volume seasonal multiplier, Jan (FRED new-listings seasonality). Was ProjectionConstants.
